Messages.Author: Murphy Christopher J
Messages.Body:
Immortal Grapple means that no one can use Dodges? Only Hand Strikes or
things which say +1 Hand strike or the like?

Messages.Author: Faulkner
Messages.Body:
3cj...@qlink.queensu.ca (Murphy Christopher J) writes:

>Immortal Grapple means that no one can use Dodges? Only Hand Strikes or
>things which say +1 Hand strike or the like?

No, only hand strikes; Strike: use +1 ahnd or melee damage is not allowable,
but if you first play a torn signpost, then you can strike with the torn
signpost because is gives the vampire 2 or 3 "hand damage.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
3cj...@qlink.queensu.ca (Murphy Christopher J) writes:

>Immortal Grapple means that no one can use Dodges? Only Hand Strikes or
>things which say +1 Hand strike or the like?

Yes. Only hand strikes. Cards which modify the damage done by a hand
strike are allowable.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
gsf5...@uxa.cso.uiuc.edu (Faulkner) writes:

>3cj...@qlink.queensu.ca (Murphy Christopher J) writes:

>>Immortal Grapple means that no one can use Dodges? Only Hand Strikes or
>>things which say +1 Hand strike or the like?

>No, only hand strikes; Strike: use +1 ahnd or melee damage is not allowable,

>but if you first play a torn signpost, then you can strike with the torn
>signpost because is gives the vampire 2 or 3 "hand damage.

Strike cards are allowed, as long as they are hand strikes. For example:
Lucky Blow is a hand strike, and may be used (as a hand strike). It may not
be used as a strike to increase the damage done by a melee weapon, of
course.

L. Scott

Messages.Author: Guy Keen
Messages.Body:
> >Immortal Grapple means that no one can use Dodges? Only Hand Strikes or
> >things which say +1 Hand strike or the like?
>
>

> No, only hand strikes; Strike: use +1 ahnd or melee damage is not allowable,
> but if you first play a torn signpost, then you can strike with the torn
> signpost because is gives the vampire 2 or 3 "hand damage.

Sorry - I have to agree with Alan Kwan's thread on this issue. The card
text says: "Only hand strikes can be made against or by the vampire
using IG." So, no range weapons, no melee weapons, just hand strikes.
I don't think that prevents you from playing other cards to modify the
hand strike (i.e. + damage or agg. damage), and there is nothing else
in the card text to suggest otherwise.

This issue does raise another question, (Alan, maybe you have some
idea here): Can strike: dodge and strike: end combat cards be used in a combat
after an Immortal Grapple has been played? At the moment, I tend to think not.

***Guy***

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Dodge and End Combat are not hand strikes, so such cards may not be played
by a minion restricted to using hand strikes.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
